image_description: A collection of disposable lighters arranged on a surface. The central focus is a stack of two lighters: an orange one with a white graphic (possibly a cigarette pack design) on the bottom, and a transparent/white one on top. To the left are green and blue lighters. In the background, there is another lighter with red and gold coloring. There is visible text on the packaging/background which appears distorted and illegible.

artifact_observations.location: Top left background and on the orange lighter face
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text in the upper left corner is completely nonsensical and malformed, resembling 'alien script' rather than any human language. The logo/text on the orange lighter is also distorted and illegible, a classic AI generation artifact where text rendering fails.

artifact_observations.location: Surface of the lighters, particularly the green and blue ones
artifact_observations.reasoning: The plastic surfaces lack the sharp specular highlights and micro-scratches expected from real plastic. They have a slightly 'waxy' or smeared appearance, lacking high-frequency detail.

artifact_observations.location: Junction between the stacked orange and transparent lighters
artifact_observations.reasoning: The boundary between the two stacked lighters is slightly blurred and fused. The geometry of the top lighter's base doesn't sit perfectly flat on the bottom one, suggesting slight geometric instability or melting.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text artifacts. In AI images, 'almost readable' text is often a sign of lower quality generation. Also, evaluate if the stacking physics looks natural or if the objects seem to merge into each other. The 'waxy' texture of the plastic is a key indicator of generative origin versus a low-res photograph.
